<script>

'use strict';
const canvas=document.getElementById('game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
const W=canvas.width,H=canvas.height,T=20,MW=72,MH=44,worldW=MW*T,worldH=MH*T;
const ui={hp:document.getElementById('hpText'),hpBar:document.getElementById('hpBar'),xp:document.getElementById('xpText'),xpBar:document.getElementById('xpBar'),level:document.getElementById('level'),gold:document.getElementById('gold'),potions:document.getElementById('potions'),potionCount:document.getElementById('potionCount'),slain:document.getElementById('slain'),shards:document.getElementById('shardCount'),log:document.getElementById('log'),hint:document.getElementById('hint'),toast:document.getElementById('toast'),clock:document.getElementById('clock')};
const player={x:9*T,y:21*T,hp:28,maxHp:28,level:1,xp:0,next:30,gold:12,potions:2,slain:0,face:'down',walk:0,attack:0,invuln:0};
const elder={x:12*T,y:21*T};
const shards=[{x:20*T,y:12*T,got:false},{x:37*T,y:34*T,got:false},{x:49*T,y:10*T,got:false}];
const chest={x:16*T,y:31*T,opened:false};
const enemies=[{x:25*T,y:17*T,hp:14,max:14,alive:true,phase:0,hit:0},{x:36*T,y:31*T,hp:16,max:16,alive:true,phase:2,hit:0},{x:47*T,y:16*T,hp:18,max:18,alive:true,phase:1,hit:0},{x:57*T,y:25*T,hp:20,max:20,alive:true,phase:3,hit:0}];
const route=[[5,22],[13,22],[18,20],[23,19],[29,20],[34,23],[40,22],[45,20],[51,19],[58,19],[65,22]];
const rnd=(x,y,n=0)=>{let a=Math.sin(x*127.1+y*311.7+n*74.7)*43758.5453;return a-Math.floor(a)};
function routeDist(x,y){let best=999;for(let i=0;i<route.length-1;i++){let [ax,ay]=route[i],[bx,by]=route[i+1],dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-ax)*dx+(y-ay)*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy)));best=Math.min(best,Math.hypot(x-(ax+t*dx),y-(ay+t*dy)))}return best}
function creekY(x){return 28+Math.sin(x*.17)*1.15+Math.sin(x*.43)*.35}
function isWater(x,y){return Math.abs(y-creekY(x))<1.35 && !(x>29&&x<33)}
function isPath(x,y){return routeDist(x,y)<1.02}
const trees=[];
for(let y=2;y<MH-2;y++)for(let x=2;x<MW-2;x++){
 if(rnd(x,y,1)>.105)continue;
 const nearPath=routeDist(x+.5,y+.5)<1.65, water=Math.abs(y+.5-creekY(x+.5))<2.1;
 const clearing=Math.hypot(x+.5-54,y+.5-19)<5.4||Math.hypot(x+.5-12,y+.5-21)<3.2;
 const landmark=shards.some(s=>Math.hypot(x+.5-s.x/T,y+.5-s.y/T)<2.1)||Math.hypot(x+.5-chest.x/T,y+.5-chest.y/T)<2;
 if(!nearPath&&!water&&!clearing&&!landmark&&rnd(x,y,2)>.12)trees.push({x:x*T+2+rnd(x,y,3)*5,y:y*T+3+rnd(x,y,4)*5,s:15+rnd(x,y,5)*8,hue:rnd(x,y,6)})
}
const flowers=[];for(let y=3;y<MH-3;y++)for(let x=3;x<MW-3;x++)if(rnd(x,y,7)>.91&&!isPath(x+.5,y+.5)&&Math.abs(y+.5-creekY(x+.5))>2)flowers.push({x:x*T+4+rnd(x,y,8)*12,y:y*T+5+rnd(x,y,9)*10,c:rnd(x,y,10)>.5?'#e7c980':'#d89cb1'});
function rect(x,y,w,h,c){ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),Math.ceil(w),Math.ceil(h))}
function drawGround(camX,camY){
 const tx0=Math.floor(camX/T)-1,ty0=Math.floor(camY/T)-1,tx1=tx0+W/T+3,ty1=ty0+H/T+3;
 for(let ty=ty0;ty<ty1;ty++)for(let tx=tx0;tx<tx1;tx++){
  if(tx<0||ty<0||tx>=MW||ty>=MH)continue;
  const sx=tx*T-camX,sy=ty*T-camY;
  const water=isWater(tx+.5,ty+.5),path=isPath(tx+.5,ty+.5);
  if(water){rect(sx,sy,T,T,'#366d70');rect(sx,sy+3,T,2,'#478b83');if(rnd(tx,ty,12)>.6)rect(sx+4+rnd(tx,ty,13)*10,sy+11,4,1,'#73aba0');continue}
  if(path){rect(sx,sy,T,T,'#796d4d');if(rnd(tx,ty,14)>.48)rect(sx+3+rnd(tx,ty,15)*12,sy+4+rnd(tx,ty,16)*12,2,2,'#9b8a5e');if(rnd(tx,ty,17)>.87)rect(sx+5,sy+15,7,1,'#5e6249');continue}
  rect(sx,sy,T,T,((tx+ty)%2?'#456e4e':'#47734f'));
  if(rnd(tx,ty,18)>.57)rect(sx+3+rnd(tx,ty,19)*13,sy+3+rnd(tx,ty,20)*13,2,2,rnd(tx,ty,21)>.5?'#558253':'#3e6748');
  if(rnd(tx,ty,22)>.91)rect(sx+12,sy+5,2,3,'#8baa62');
 }
 // winding stream surface shimmer
 for(let x=Math.max(0,tx0);x<Math.min(MW,tx1);x++){
  let yy=creekY(x)*T-camY;
  for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++){let sy=yy+k*T; if(sy>-T&&sy<H)rect(x*T-camX,sy,T,5,k===0?'#478781':'#32666a')}
 }
 // wooden footbridge across the creek
 let bx=30*T-camX,by=creekY(30)*T-camY-12;
 rect(bx-5,by+3,74,29,'#5a4934');rect(bx-3,by,70,26,'#9b7549');
 for(let i=0;i<7;i++){rect(bx+i*10,by,2,26,'#735438');rect(bx+i*10+3,by+5,4,1,'#b48b59')}
 rect(bx-5,by-2,74,3,'#bf9862');rect(bx-5,by+25,74,3,'#735337');
 // tall grass tufts along the stream banks
 for(let x=Math.max(0,tx0);x<Math.min(MW,tx1);x+=2){let sy=creekY(x)*T-camY;for(let side of [-1,1])if(rnd(x,Math.round(sy/T),24)>.25){let gx=x*T-camX+8;rect(gx,sy+side*25,2,7,'#738e52');rect(gx+3,sy+side*22,2,6,'#91a45b')}}
 // scattered flowers and stones
 for(const f of flowers){let x=f.x-camX,y=f.y-camY;if(x>-10&&x<W+10&&y>-10&&y<H+10){rect(x,y+2,2,3,'#8fb05a');rect(x-1,y,4,2,f.c);rect(x,y,2,2,'#f1d89b')}}
 for(let y=5;y<MH-4;y+=4)for(let x=4;x<MW-4;x+=5)if(rnd(x,y,55)>.88){let sx=x*T-camX,sy=y*T-camY;if(sx>-15&&sx<W&&sy>-10&&sy<H&&!isPath(x+.5,y+.5)&&!isWater(x+.5,y+.5)){rect(sx+6,sy+12,7,4,'#68796b');rect(sx+8,sy+10,5,3,'#83917d')}}
}
function drawTree(t,cx,cy){let x=t.x-cx,y=t.y-cy,r=t.s;if(x< -r-8||x>W+r+8||y< -r-10||y>H+r+12)return;rect(x+5,y+r*.73,7,13,'#5c4532');rect(x+3,y+r*.72,11,3,'#74563b');
 const palettes=t.hue<.33?['#284b3b','#315a42','#3e7048','#4b8050']:t.hue<.67?['#334b37','#465e3c','#5a7043','#697c48']:['#375340','#426746','#52764a','#648652'];
 rect(x+1,y+5,r-1,r-4,palettes[0]);rect(x-3,y+10,r*.58,r*.62,palettes[1]);rect(x+r*.42,y+8,r*.62,r*.66,palettes[2]);rect(x+4,y,r*.58,r*.58,palettes[2]);rect(x+r*.35,y+2,r*.46,r*.51,palettes[3]);rect(x+5,y+4,4,3,'#87a15b');rect(x+r*.6,y+11,5,3,palettes[3]);rect(x+2,y+r*.43,5,4,palettes[3]);rect(x+3,y+r*.86,r*.72,3,'#263b30')
}
function drawShrine(x,y,cx,cy){x-=cx;y-=cy;if(x< -50||x>W+50||y< -60||y>H+60)return;
 rect(x-29,y+27,62,7,'#544d3c');rect(x-25,y+21,54,7,'#827452');rect(x-20,y+16,44,6,'#a39469');
 rect(x-19,y-22,8,39,'#9f9771');rect(x+11,y-22,8,39,'#9f9771');rect(x-21,y-25,12,5,'#c3b987');rect(x+9,y-25,12,5,'#c3b987');
 rect(x-22,y-29,44,6,'#77785c');rect(x-18,y-35,36,6,'#878663');rect(x-11,y-41,22,6,'#a2a176');rect(x-4,y-49,8,9,'#bbc28b');
 rect(x-2,y-14,4,14,'#5ee6b3');rect(x-6,y-11,12,5,'#85ffd0');rect(x-1,y-20,2,5,'#e1ffe0');rect(x-13,y-8,3,7,'#617458');rect(x+10,y-7,3,8,'#617458');
 // glow pixels
 for(let i=0;i<5;i++){let a=performance.now()/900+i*1.25,px=x+Math.cos(a)*25,py=y-12+Math.sin(a)*16;rect(px,py,2,2,'#a8ffe1')}
}
function drawWorldObjects(cx,cy){
 drawShrine(54*T,19*T,cx,cy);
 // elder Rowan, tiny hooded guide
 let x=elder.x-cx,y=elder.y-cy;rect(x-6,y+6,13,5,'#293a2d');rect(x-5,y-7,10,14,'#657c54');rect(x-7,y-10,14,8,'#a78860');rect(x-5,y-14,10,7,'#d7b681');rect(x-7,y-17,14,4,'#796347');rect(x-8,y-15,4,6,'#796347');rect(x-2,y-11,2,2,'#413e32');rect(x+3,y-11,2,2,'#413e32');rect(x-4,y+2,3,7,'#64503c');rect(x+2,y+2,3,7,'#64503c');rect(x+9,y-5,2,17,'#89643d');rect(x+8,y-7,4,3,'#d2b777');
 if(Math.hypot(player.x-elder.x,player.y-elder.y)<T*3.0){rect(x-2,y-28,5,5,'#f0d48a');rect(x-1,y-27,2,2,'#fff2bc')}
 for(const s of shards)if(!s.got){x=s.x-cx;y=s.y-cy;if(x>-30&&x<W+30&&y>-35&&y<H+30){let pulse=Math.sin(performance.now()/220)*2;rect(x-7,y+6,14,3,'#294c48');rect(x-3,y-7+pulse,6,9,'#6ce2b2');rect(x-5,y-3+pulse,10,5,'#9bffd5');rect(x-2,y-11+pulse,4,5,'#d8ffe1');rect(x-10,y-1,2,2,'#83d8b7');rect(x+8,y-8,2,2,'#83d8b7')}}
 // treasure chest
 x=chest.x-cx;y=chest.y-cy;if(!chest.opened){rect(x-8,y+5,17,4,'#343c2c');rect(x-7,y-3,15,9,'#936333');rect(x-8,y-6,17,5,'#bd8a43');rect(x-6,y-7,13,2,'#dfb864');rect(x-1,y-2,3,4,'#f6dd8d');rect(x+4,y-5,2,3,'#efca71')}

}
function drawPlayer(cx,cy){let x=player.x-cx,y=player.y-cy;let step=Math.sin(player.walk)*1.7,fl=player.invuln>0&&Math.floor(performance.now()/90)%2===0;if(fl)return;

 // boots and legs

 // satchel and cloak
 rect(x-8,y-4,16,10,'#7c5941');rect(x-7,y-7,14,12,'#608054');rect(x-6,y-8,12,12,'#78985b');rect(x-7,y+1,14,3,'#536c45');rect(x-8,y-2,3,7,'#d2ae6c');rect(x+5,y-3,3,4,'#a1bb70');
 // face and hair
 rect(x-5,y-15,10,9,'#edc28f');rect(x-7,y-18,14,6,'#66513b');rect(x-7,y-15,3,6,'#66513b');rect(x+4,y-15,3,5,'#66513b');rect(x-4,y-12,2,2,'#4c4434');rect(x+2,y-12,2,2,'#4c4434');rect(x-2,y-8,4,1,'#bf8568');
